outcome.answer: Across time, genre, and editing conditions, writing style can shift in measurable ways rather than remaining fixed. In a study of scientific preprints, the authors find post-2022 changes in multiple linguistic feature families (e.g., increases in average word length, reduced formula-based readability, and changes in dependency-tree depth), with different features showing different trajectories (some rising persistently and others rising then receding) [4]. Across genre and years, a German authorship-verification benchmark shows performance degradation as the time gap between documents increases, indicating temporal drift affects stylistic patterns used for attribution [2].
